name: Machika Yuuki
source:
She is a brilliant woman, and is the director of the Duke's Operations Command and Kurosu's superior. She is also Kurosu's sister, kind of.

At first, she was commenting on the protagonist's reports at the dukes' command center, but then she thought it would be interesting and came to the school as a teacher herself.

[From [url=https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=519805]getchu[/url]]
